name: ensemble_v15
information: v15 = v12 stacking pipeline with LightGBM (three seeds) and XGBoost retrained on the v15 panel (v14 inputs, corrected event labels, three bad station-days out of the training targets), day-type weights, and the corrections of v13/v14 refitted on local out-of-fold residuals (nested, date-blocked). No leaderboard score is read or stored. v15e = v15 + the entries below, which rest on realised facts of the evaluation period (allowed by the organisers) and on ridership before the cutoff only; they cannot be validated on any fold.

extras.name: SSG 랜더스페셜 매치 '최광야구 1429' (23,000석 매진, 17:30 시작, 7이닝 + 시상)

scenarios.note: ends by 20:39
ends 21:00-21:29 (same length as the 2025 match)

extras.basis: Held and sold out (press of 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-05).  Without this entry the day is forecast as an ordinary Saturday (21h: about 140).  Crowd leaving by this station from the home-game relation of the training period (boardings in the two hours after the end = 0.263 x attendance + 204, about 6,300 for 23,000).  The end is not published.  The same event a year earlier (2025-10-24, 18:00 start) had 391 / 5,279 / 1,140 boardings at 20 / 21 / 22h, which by the split curve means an end near 21:30, i.e. about three and a half hours; the same length from 17:30 gives 21:00, a three-hour match 20:30.  Split of the leaving crowd between hour cells: outputs/ensemble_v15/external/exit_split_by_end_minute.csv (home games of the training period: an end before :40 puts 79-95 % into the hour of the end, an end at :40-:49 37 %, at :50-:59 18 %).

it does not: forecast kept

extras.basis: Training data: on the second Saturday of March, April, May and June 2026 the 12h boardings were 791 / 1,192 / 932 / 1,105 (other Saturdays of those months: 208) and the 11h boardings 225 / 406 / 373 / 528 (219); nothing of the kind on any second Saturday before March 2026.  The cause is not identified and nobody could confirm that it continued, so the entry is the probability-weighted mean in log space (p = probability that it took place; lower in August and on the long weekend of 10 October).

extras.basis: The 2025 race (2025-09-28) gave 713 and 746 boardings at 10h and 11h against 242 and 261 on the neighbouring Sundays (x2.9). The retrained model of v14 already raises these two hours by about 30 %; x1.4 on top brings the forecast to roughly 55 % of the 2025 log effect (one earlier race only).

summer_leave.name: 여름 집단휴가 2주 (평일 7/27~8/7)
summer_leave.basis: Weekday boardings fell in the week holding 1 August and the following week in every year of the daily card data (nine years, mean -0.09 and -0.07 log against mid-July and late August); the mean of the other years reproduced the 2025 fall of our own stations (-0.100 vs -0.107, -0.076 vs -0.075). Per station and hour group, half of the difference between the 2025 fall and the fall the forecast already holds is applied, only where 2025 was deeper. Which of the two weeks is deeper in 2026 is not known, so both get the same shift.
